events.headline: Data warehouse auto-sync removed from pricing-page feature list
events.summary: A dated page comparison shows removal of “Auto-sync with data warehouse”; it does not establish whether the capability was discontinued or moved elsewhere.

events.headline: Workflow spending limits and agent-access controls released
events.summary: Clay added workflow credit limits, MCP client allowlisting, Audiences privacy deletion through its API, and enrichment-search handoff to Sculptor.

events.headline: Claygent auto-mode launches
events.summary: New Claygents default to automatic model selection, routing each task to a model chosen to balance research quality and cost.

events.headline: SCIM provisioning and expanded workflow and search capabilities released
events.summary: Clay added identity-provider provisioning, Audiences record upserts, signals-to-workflows handoff, and metro-area search.

events.headline: Redesigned home page and Audiences export tools released
events.summary: Clay refreshed its home page, consolidated Audiences source and export visibility, enabled exports via Workflows, and improved Ads match-rate reporting.

events.headline: Agent-first Clay experience introduced at Sculpt
events.summary: Clay introduced an agent that plans and executes GTM tasks using Knowledge Hub context, initially available to conference attendees with further early-access rollout planned.

events.headline: Clay Workflows beta opens to all users
events.summary: Clay announced universal beta availability for its visual workflow canvas, supporting branching, loops, code, agents, natural-language building, and visual run tracing.

events.headline: Inbound SDR Agent previewed with pre-beta waitlist
events.summary: Clay previewed an agent designed to qualify inbound leads through voice conversations and demonstrate customers’ products, inviting pre-beta partners.

events.headline: Workflow budgets, bulk reruns, and CLI advertising controls released
events.summary: Clay added workflow credit budgets, bulk workflow reruns, trusted-domain workspace access, Ads management through its CLI, and redesigned Audiences record details.

events.headline: Clay Skills Marketplace opens
events.summary: The marketplace offers community-built GTM skills for coding agents, free to install, with Clay credits consumed when skills retrieve Clay data.

events.headline: New and updated data integrations announced
events.summary: Clay expanded integrations covering EMEA and APAC data, buying signals, industry-specific enrichment, dialers, CRMs, and warehouses.

events.headline: LinkedIn company-list syncing and IP access restrictions released
events.summary: Clay added company-list syncing and recurring-sync controls for LinkedIn Ads, workspace IP restrictions, connection-usage tracing, and faster workspace creation.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
